news.title: Master Tec Group CEO Tee Kok Hwa Resigns Effective 31 Oct 2026

recent_en: MTEC signed a memorandum of understanding and provided financial assistance on 12 November 2026, while releasing its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026. Earlier, CEO Tee Kok Hwa resigned effective 31 October 2026.
notable_en: CEO Tee Kok Hwa resigned effective 31 October 2026.
